plan.title: chore(deps): raise `packageManager` pnpm to >= 11.11.0 (upstream pnpm security advisories)

narratives.Description: chore(deps): raise `packageManager` pnpm to >= 11.11.0 (upstream pnpm security advisories)
narratives.Overview:
- relieves: P1 — Set root package.json packageManager to a pnpm release ≥ 11.11.0; preferred instance pnpm@11.28.9 (npm latest-11), or pnpm@11.11.0 if the P3 ladder fires
- relieves: P2 — Leave that pin as the sole distribution fix for packageManager readers (workflows plus tasks/engine-pm-run.cjs corepack pnpm@semver)
- relieves: P3 — Record pnpm --version with a successful pnpm install --frozen-lockfile against the original committed lockfile and no unrelated dependency churn; on freeze failure at 11.28.9 fall back to pnpm@11.11.0; on floor freeze failure halt for lockfile-migration Recut (no silent lockfile regenerate)
- relieves: P4 — Resolve-probe pull_request packageManager readers only (ci.yml including Windows corepack prepare --activate consumer-fixture path, ci-lane.yml, branch-gate.yml, greenfield-python-free-smoke.yml pnpm/action-setup without version)
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer I want packageManager-pnpm-raise-ge-11-11-0-security so Prefer-A Bound remedy ships through merge.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Implement Prefer-A Bound limbs for #6021; verify via swarm.verify_commands; CHANGELOG Unreleased.
